description: Laravel package that automatically generates HTML forms and read-only tables from any PHP object or Eloquent model, based on property types
rules: Describe model properties with PHPDoc @property annotations — the annotated type determines the form widget
Mark models with the #[Aura] attribute or define policies; otherwise the Gate denies access and the form renders empty
Render an editable form with <x-formster::form :object="$model" action="..."/> and a read-only table with <x-formster::form.table :object="$model"/>
A nullable property type replaces the required rule with present|nullable and adds a "not specified" option to the enum and relationship dropdowns
Type a property with a related model class and give the model a matching belongsTo method to get a dropdown of related records
Track or veto updates with the ObjectChanging / PropertyChanging / PropertyChanged / ObjectChanged events; returning false from a ...Changing listener cancels the write
